title: Runtime configuration of the bundled screens
description: The object a deployment assigns to window.__AUTHWAY_CONFIG__ in config.js, served next to the screen's index.html (the login UI at its root, the console at its base path). The same build of a screen runs under any address: a deployment changes config.js, never the build. Every key is optional; a key that is absent falls back to the value the screen was built with, then to its default. config.js must be served uncached.

apiUrl.description: Base URL of the Authway API, without a trailing slash (one is trimmed). An empty string means the screen's own origin — the API is served on the same address, as in a single-origin installation. Read by both screens.

issuerUrl.description: The OIDC issuer the deployment's applications are configured with. Shown by the console for reference; nothing is requested from it. Read by the console.

appInsightsConnectionString.description: An Azure Application Insights connection string. Browser telemetry is off when it is empty or absent. Read by both screens.
